decision.reason: Planner v1 violated its preregistered structured-output and zero-provider-error guardrails. The attempt was terminated without coercion, retry, or partial-metric selection.

limitations: No retrieval-quality metrics are reported because the complete validation sample was not executed.
Usage and cost for the invalid provider response were unavailable because parsing failed before the response was persisted.
The one successfully parsed response is reported only for operational accounting and is not used to estimate retrieval quality.
